lesson.1.title: How AI works
lesson.1.lede: First you build a tool for your own business. Then we see where AI runs, what tokens and context are, and which model to pick. Kit 1: where the work goes.
lesson.2.title: Introduction
lesson.2.lede: We look at what AI actually is, how models work, and why context decides everything. Practice: NotebookLM.
lesson.3.title: Claude Code
lesson.3.lede: You learn Claude Code on your own Kit 1 files: the company folder, CLAUDE.md, a plan and a PRD. Kit 2: pick the process to start with.
lesson.4.title: API and MCP
lesson.4.lede: We split the chosen process into steps and write the agent's instructions. Then we connect the first version of the agent to real systems. Kit 3: redistributing the work.

course.title: All lessons
prep.0.s0: Bring your own laptop to the lessons. The whole practicum is hands-on.
prep.0.s1: Check that you have admin rights: you need to install programs. If it is a work computer, ask your IT team.
prep.0.s2: Keep at least 5 GB of free disk space.
prep.1.s1: Enter your first name, last name and a new email address.
prep.1.s2: Confirm your phone number. A code arrives by SMS.
prep.1.s3: Write the password down: you will need it in class.
prep.2.s0: Go to claude.ai and sign up with “Continue with Google”.
prep.2.s1: In Settings → Billing choose the Pro plan. It costs $20 a month.
prep.2.s2: Pay with an international Visa or Mastercard. The card needs a dollar balance and online payments switched on. Uzcard and Humo do not work.
prep.2.s3: Install the Claude app from claude.ai/download and sign in with the same account.
prep.2.foot: From Lesson 02 you use Claude Code a lot, and the Pro limit can run out fast. Then switch to Max (from $100 a month).
prep.3.s0: Download Warp from warp.dev and install it.
prep.3.s3: Type claude and press Enter. A browser opens: sign in with your Claude account.
prep.3.s4: If Claude Code answers your greeting, you are ready.
prep.3.foot: If the install fails, send a screenshot of the error to your mentor. Mentors help at the end of Lesson 01.
